scenes.text: This tutorial covers Report. Create a shareable HTML or PDF summary containing quality control, figures, statistics, settings, and versions.
Open Report from the Results and quality control section. Choose a completed spaCR project and the runs, tables, figures, and sections to include.
In the main configuration area, configure title, authorship, condition labels, quality thresholds, output format, and privacy-sensitive fields.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. preview the report and resolve missing files or failed quality checks before export.
When the workflow finishes, a portable report records conclusions together with the settings and software versions needed to reproduce them.
